source: Detailed CEN 01/2026 (ALP), published on the official RRB websites: https://rrbsecunderabad.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/detail-cen-01-2026-eng-.pdf
intro: CBT 1 is a screening paper of Mathematics, Mental Ability and General Science. CBT 2 Part A carries Basic Science and Engineering, and Part B is a trade test in your ITI trade.
note: The 2026 CEN lists no separate General Awareness or current affairs area for ALP (the 2025 CEN still had one covering current affairs, science and technology, sports, culture, personalities, economics and politics), so confirm the areas in the notice of the cycle you apply under.

topics: Engineering drawing: projections, views, drawing instruments, lines, geometric figures, symbolic representation

sections.tip: CBT 1 tests the three 10th-standard science areas. The Basic Science and Engineering block sits in CBT 2 Part A and is the biggest scoring difference from NTPC-style papers, so start it early.
